# Outlook
> Microsoft Outlook is an email, calendar, contacts, and productivity service in Microsoft 365 for personal and business use.

Outlook spans consumer webmail at Outlook.com and enterprise email, calendar, and integration capabilities across Microsoft 365, Exchange, and the Microsoft Graph platform.

## Outlook Product
- [Outlook](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/outlook/email-and-calendar-software-microsoft-outlook): Overview of Outlook email, calendar, and productivity features in Microsoft 365.
- [Outlook for Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/outlook/outlook-for-windows): Product information for the Outlook experience on Windows.
- [Outlook for Mac](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/outlook/outlook-for-mac): Product information for Outlook on macOS.
- [Outlook for iOS and Android](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/outlook-mobile-for-android-and-ios): Mobile Outlook app features for phones and tablets.
- [Outlook.com](https://outlook.live.com/): Consumer Outlook webmail entry point for email, calendar, and contacts.

## Outlook Help
- [Outlook Help Center](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook): Central support hub for Outlook products and scenarios.
- [Outlook.com Help](https://support.microsoft.com/outlook_com): Help articles for Outlook.com email, calendar, and account tasks.
- [New Outlook for Windows Help](https://support.microsoft.com/new-outlook): Support content for the new Outlook for Windows experience.
- [Classic Outlook for Windows Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/outlook-help-and-learning-6d4a2b8f-c577-4f4f-b7e3-6b8f4c4f6b2f): Help and learning resources for classic Outlook desktop.
- [Outlook for Mac Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/outlook-for-mac-help-51f3f0c2-0f9c-4f5d-9d6d-8f0d0d7d0f0d): Support articles for Outlook on macOS.
- [Outlook Mobile Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/outlook-for-ios-and-android-help-ced6f0ac-0d7f-4f0f-9a0d-0f0d0f0d0f0d): Help for Outlook mobile apps on iOS and Android.

## Outlook.com Setup and Use
- [Sign in to Outlook.com](https://outlook.live.com/mail/): Web access to Outlook.com mailbox and related apps.
- [Create a Microsoft account](https://signup.live.com/): Account creation for Outlook.com and Microsoft consumer services.
- [Get help with Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/get-help-with-outlook-com-49cc4fce-1dfb-4d2f-bf69-3b0b7f9f0f0f): Troubleshooting and usage help for Outlook.com.
- [Import email and contacts to Outlook.com](https://support.microsoft.com/office/import-email-and-contacts-to-outlook-com-431a8e9a-f99f-4f0f-8f7d-0f0d0f0d0f0d): Guidance for migrating mail and contacts into Outlook.com.
- [Add an email account to Outlook](https://support.microsoft.com/office/add-an-email-account-to-outlook-e9da47c4-9b89-4b49-9a9f-0f0d0f0d0f0d): Steps for connecting additional mail accounts in Outlook.
- [Export or backup email, contacts, and calendar](https://support.microsoft.com/office/export-or-backup-email-contacts-and-calendar-to-an-outlook-pst-file-14252b52-3075-4e9b-be4e-ff9ef1068f91): Instructions for backing up Outlook data locally.

## Microsoft Graph Outlook APIs
- [Microsoft Graph Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/overview): Introduction to Microsoft Graph APIs and core concepts.
- [Outlook API resources in Microsoft Graph](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/mail-api-overview): Overview of mail, calendar, contacts, and related Outlook resources.
- [Use the Outlook mail API](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/mail-api-overview): Mail API concepts for messages, folders, and attachments.
- [Use the Outlook calendar API](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/calendar-overview): Calendar API concepts for events and scheduling.
- [Use the Outlook contacts API](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/contact): Reference entry point for Outlook contact resources.
- [Choose authentication providers](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/sdks/choose-authentication-providers): Authentication options for calling Microsoft Graph from apps.

## Microsoft Graph API Reference
- [Message resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/message): Reference for Outlook message properties and relationships.
- [Mail folder resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/mailfolder): Reference for mail folder operations and structure.
- [Event resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/event): Reference for calendar event fields and behaviors.
- [Calendar resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/calendar): Reference for Outlook calendar objects.
- [Contact resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/contact): Reference for contact properties and methods.
- [User sendMail](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/user-sendmail): API for sending mail as a user.
- [List messages](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/user-list-messages): API for retrieving messages from a mailbox.
- [Create event](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/user-post-events): API for creating calendar events.

## Outlook Add-ins and Extensibility
- [Outlook add-ins overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/outlook/outlook-add-ins-overview): Introduction to building Outlook add-ins across clients.
- [Outlook JavaScript API overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/reference/overview/outlook-add-ins-reference-overview): Overview of the Outlook JavaScript API surface.
- [Outlook add-in manifests](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/develop/xml-manifest-overview): Manifest structure for Outlook and Office add-ins.
- [Event-based activation in Outlook](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/outlook/autolaunch): Build add-ins that respond to Outlook events automatically.
- [On-send feature for Outlook add-ins](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/outlook/outlook-on-send-addins): Validate or process messages before sending.
- [Publish Office Add-ins](https://learn.microsoft.com/office/dev/add-ins/publish/publish): Deployment and publishing options for Office and Outlook add-ins.

## Exchange and Enterprise Administration
- [Exchange Server documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/exchange/): Documentation for Exchange Server deployment and administration.
- [Exchange Online documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/exchange/exchange-online): Admin guidance for Exchange Online in Microsoft 365.
- [Exchange admin center](https://admin.exchange.microsoft.com/): Web portal for managing Exchange Online organizations.
- [Microsoft 365 admin center](https://admin.microsoft.com/): Central administration portal for Microsoft 365 services including Outlook.
- [Set up connectors in Exchange Online](https://learn.microsoft.com/exchange/mail-flow-best-practices/use-connectors-to-configure-mail-flow/set-up-connectors-to-route-mail): Configure mail flow connectors for Exchange Online.
- [Mail flow rules in Exchange Online](https://learn.microsoft.com/exchange/security-and-compliance/mail-flow-rules/mail-flow-rules): Manage transport rules for message processing and compliance.

## Identity and Account Access
- [Microsoft account](https://account.microsoft.com/): Consumer account management for Outlook.com and Microsoft services.
- [Microsoft Entra ID documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/): Identity platform documentation for organizational access and authentication.
- [Microsoft identity platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/): Developer guidance for sign-in, tokens, and app registration.
- [App registrations](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-register-app): Register applications for Microsoft Graph and Outlook integrations.
- [OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols): Protocol guidance for Microsoft identity authentication flows.

## Security and Compliance
- [Microsoft Defender for Office 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-office-365/): Security documentation for protecting email and collaboration workloads.
- [Exchange Online Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/exchange/antispam-and-antimalware/exchange-online-protection-overview): Overview of spam and malware protection for Exchange Online.
- [Secure messages by using Microsoft Purview Message Encryption](https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/message-encryption): Guidance for encrypted email in Microsoft 365.
- [Data Loss Prevention in Exchange Online](https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-learn-about-dlp): Compliance overview for preventing sensitive data leakage.
- [Safe Links in Microsoft Defender for Office 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-office-365/safe-links-about): Protection against malicious URLs in email messages.
- [Safe Attachments in Microsoft Defender for Office 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-office-365/safe-attachments-about): Protection against malicious email attachments.
